stage.live.help: Contributions are open. Colleagues contribute to the family directly, throughout the drive.
stage.closed.help: Contributions have finished. They are now being checked against bank records.
stage.verified.help: Every contribution has been checked against bank records. The drive stays here as a permanent record.
stage.explainer.a11y: What these stages mean — opens an explanation of each stage

$comment.index_line: ⭐⭐ TRUSTEE-RATIFIED (Dhiraj Rahul + Kalpana Bharti, 2026-09-05) — routing note §9.2, ruling 3 at §10.2. ⛔ AUTHORED HERE, RENDERED NOWHERE YET: `{amount}` and `{nominee_name}` are BOTH dark until story D (11b-14 AC7 / Task 8) supplies them. ⭐ `t()` THROWS on an unsupplied token (`resolver.ts:36-42`) — ⚠ ⛔ NOT the silent empty-figure the story's AC9 assumed; CHECKED, ⛔ not assumed — so a premature render fails LOUDLY rather than shipping a blank ₹. ⛔ Render none of these until every token is supplied. ⭐ RULING 3: an absent token DROPS ITS CLAUSE — ⛔ no combinatorial variants; pick the ONE variant naming the absent token. ⚠ `no_family` drops the district clause TOO, because 'who served in … district' modifies the DECEASED MEMBER — leaving it would attribute the posting district to the NOMINEE.
